gpu.unsaveable.venus.message: the machine is using Vulkan (Venus), whose state can't be saved yet
gpu.unsaveable.venus.note: Why a snapshot can't be taken, shown in the message bar as the detail under “the machine can't be saved” (Snapshot, Save snapshot or Suspend while the machine runs): a program in the guest uses Vulkan, whose state snapshots don't hold yet.

gpu.unsaveable.virgl.message: the machine is using 3D (virgl), and this renderer can't be saved
gpu.unsaveable.virgl.note: Why a snapshot can't be taken, shown in the message bar as the detail under “the machine can't be saved” (Snapshot, Save snapshot or Suspend while the machine runs): a program in the guest uses 3D, and the renderer drawing it can't save its state.

gpu-worker.unreadable3d.note: Why a snapshot can't be taken, shown in the message bar as the detail under “the machine can't be saved” (Snapshot, Save snapshot or Suspend while the machine runs): reading back the 3D renderer's state failed; the renderer's error follows it as a further detail.

virgl-renderer.unsaveable.video.message: a video is being decoded through the GPU: close the video player first
virgl-renderer.unsaveable.video.note: Why a snapshot can't be taken, shown in the message bar as the detail under “the machine can't be saved” (Snapshot, Save snapshot or Suspend while the machine runs): the guest is decoding a video through the browser's decoders, whose pictures can't be saved.

main.webglLost.message: The browser lost the WebGL context the screen was drawn with.
main.webglLost.note: Error in the message bar (under the toolbar) when the browser took away the 3D screen's WebGL context (the machine has crashed; Show serial log and the like follow).

main.gpuWorkerFailed.note: Error headline in the message bar (under the toolbar) when the worker that draws a 3D machine's screen failed (the machine has crashed); the browser's error is the detail under it.
